name: Home Services
title: Field Sales Team for Home Services | Our Wellness Network
description: Field sales for home service businesses in Naperville and Hinsdale: we visit the hardware stores, real estate offices and movers near you and build a network you can track.
cardBlurb: We visit the hardware stores, real estate offices and movers near you and build a network you can track.
intro: We visit the businesses homeowners deal with near you, build relationships with their staff and turn them into a referral network you can track. Every stop and every sign-up shows up in your portal.
partnersIntro: People buying, renting, moving into or fixing up a home deal with these businesses, often right when a job comes up.

partners.name: Hardware stores
partners.why: Homeowners come in for parts and supplies, and some find out partway through that the job needs a pro.

partners.name: Real estate offices
partners.why: Buyers and sellers need repairs, upgrades and move-in work done, often on a deadline.

partners.name: Property management offices
partners.why: Managers keep a short list of pros they can call for every unit and every tenant request.

partners.name: Moving companies
partners.why: People settling into a new home need a whole list of local pros they can trust.

partners.name: Self-storage facilities
partners.why: Renters are often in the middle of a move, a remodel or both.

partners.name: Appliance stores
partners.why: A new washer or range can need a plumber or an electrician to finish the job.

treatsIntro: Every visit starts the same way: coffee and treats for the whole staff at each partner business, from the counter to the back office. It's simple hospitality, it's included in your plan, and it's the reason staff are glad when our field team walks in.
treatExamples: Coffee and donuts for a hardware store's opening crew
Bagels and coffee for a real estate office's morning meeting
Muffins and coffee for a property management office's front desk
portalNote: In your portal you see every stop we make for you and every sign-up that comes through a partner's code, ready for your office to call back and schedule. It's how you see which partnerships are working, business by business.

notes.title: A one-page partner agreement
notes.text: Every partner business signs a one-page agreement: mutual promotion, and nobody is paid per referral or per customer.

notes.title: No one in your trade
notes.text: Our matching software leaves businesses in your trade off your route, and we skip the agents, managers and suppliers you already work with unless you ask.

notes.title: Your words only
notes.text: We describe your services only in words you've approved, and we leave only the printed materials you've signed off on.

exclusivity: Partners agree to promote one business in your trade, yours, for as long as you are a client.

faq.q: Will you visit other businesses in my trade?
faq.a: No. Our matching software ranks the businesses near you that share your customers and don't compete with you. You approve the list before we visit anyone.

faq.q: I already know a few real estate agents. Will you visit them?
faq.a: Not unless you ask. We skip any business you already work with, and you approve the full list before any visit.
Every sign-up shows up in your portal with the business and staff member whose code it came through, so your office can call back and set up the job. It also shows you which partnerships are working.

aboutText: I'm asking about field sales for my home service business.
